assumptions: Implements a new experimental water_sort package because the supplied registry has no Water Sort runtime.
Arrays are bottom-to-top; pours move the maximal contiguous top color group that fits into an empty or same-color destination.
A solved tube is empty or full and monochromatic; all tubes must be solved for victory.
Animation visuals derive only from authoritative state; no liquid animation mutates game data.
Added public pour action alias, live acceptance logging and center-of-tube pointer projection; interruption/cancel changes selection only, never liquid state.
A single 240 ms visual-only pour cue begins after the native pour commits; Escape cancels the cue without changing authoritative tubes. RAF and advanceTime share the same cue timer.
